cues.en: Now then, where the hell are we? I've lost track of how long I've been speaking, because I didn't start my stopwatch. I have had a technical education. And every time I've been on a faculty, I've been in the English department, although I've never been an English major. And I have tried to bring scientific thinking to
cues.zh: 好，我们讲到哪儿了？我忘了自己讲了多久，因为没按秒表。我受过工科教育。而且每次我留校任教，都是在英语系，尽管我从没主修过英语。我也曾试着把科学思维带入

cues.en: literary criticism and there's been very little gratitude for this. Now, stories have very simple shapes, ones that computers can understand. This is the GI axis, good fortune, ill fortune, death, terrible disease, poverty, boisterous, good health, happiness up here. This is the BE axis, beginning entropy. Now then,
cues.zh: 文学批评，但根本没人领情。其实，故事的形态非常简单，简单到计算机都能理解。这是 GI 轴：好运、厄运、死亡、恶疾、贫困；上面则是生龙活虎、健康、幸福。这是 BE 轴：开始（Beginning）、熵（Entropy）。那么，

cues.en: I'll give you a marketing tip. There's people who can afford education and buying books and magazines and all that who can read. Don't like to read about people who are poor or sick. So start your story up here. Now, the simplest story, and if you stay home and watch this on television, it'll be told again and again and again.
cues.zh: 我给你们个营销建议。那些供得起教育、买得起书报杂志的识字阶层，并不喜欢看穷人或病人的故事。所以，把你的故事开局设在这里。现在，最简单的故事来了，如果你窝在家里看电视，会一遍又一遍地看到它。

cues.en: Nobody ever gets tired of this story. I call it man in a hole, but it needn't be about a man in a hole somebody Gets into trouble Gets out of it again The far end is a little higher than where we began because you know the reader thinks well by God I'm a human being too I must have that much in reserve if I get into trouble or whatever Now another story that's very popular
cues.zh: 谁也不会听腻这种故事。我称之为“跌入坑中的人”，但主角不一定真掉进坑里。就是某人遇到了麻烦，随后又摆脱了困境。结局比起点还要略高一点，因为读者会想：“天哪，我也是人，要是遇到麻烦，我也一定能挺过去。” 还有另一种很受欢迎的故事，

cues.en: And none of these are copyrighted. I call it boy meets girl, but it needn't be about a boy or a girl. It's somebody on a day like any other day. Comes across something perfectly wonderful. Oh boy! This is my lucky day. Shit. And gets it back again.
cues.zh: 这些全都没有版权保护。我管它叫“男孩遇见女孩”，但主角不一定是男孩或女孩。它讲的是某人在平常的一天，偶然遇到一件极棒的美事。“天呐！今天真是我的幸运日。”“见鬼。”随后又失而复得。

cues.en: As has been said, I have a master's degree in anthropology from the University of Chicago. So does Saul Bellow. I don't know what you want to make of that. Anyway, it was a big mistake. I can't stand primitive people. They're so stupid. But anyway, proof of their stupidity was I went to the library and dug up
cues.zh: 正如大家所知，我拥有芝加哥大学的人类学硕士学位。Saul Bellow 也是。我不知道你们对此怎么看。总之，那是大错特错。我受不了原始人，他们太蠢了。不过，能证明他们愚蠢的是，我去了图书馆，翻出了

cues.en: Stories they told, you know, they've been gathered by missionaries and ethnographers and imperialists of other sorts and Boy, they stories stunk. They were just dead level Like the B e axis there, you know, we came to a river we came to a mountain little beaver died and you can't you can't tell You can't tell what the good news is and what the bad news is You look at the wonderful rise and fall of our stories
cues.zh: 他们讲的故事。那些由传教士、民族志学者和其他形形色色的帝国主义者收集的故事。天哪，那些故事烂透了。简直一平如洗，就像那条 BE 轴一样。“我们来到一条河边，我们来到一座山前，小海狸死了。”你根本分不清哪个是好消息，哪个是坏消息。看看我们故事中那精彩的跌宕起伏，

cues.en: And, you know, they deserve to lose. Another story, it's very popular, and it breaks my rule. It starts down here. It's a young girl, teenage, I guess, maybe 17, 18. Why is she so low? Well, her mother's died. It's reading enough, right? And her father has remarried almost immediately to a terrible old battle axe with two mean daughters. And there's a party.
cues.zh: 所以说，他们活该被淘汰。另一个故事也很受欢迎，而且打破了我的规则。它从最底层开始。一个年轻女孩，十来岁吧，大概十七八岁。为什么她起点这么低？因为她母亲去世了，这理由够了吧？而她父亲几乎立刻再婚，娶了个凶神恶煞的老泼妇，还带了两个尖酸刻薄的女儿。然后，有一场舞会。

cues.en: at the palace that night. You've heard it. All right, so she has to help her new mother and her sisters, her new sisters, get dressed for this party. And she doesn't get to go. No, no, she's not good enough to go, but they are. So does she get even sad or no? She's a stout-hearted little girl with maximum grief as death of her mother. So everybody leaves for the party.
cues.zh: 那天晚上在宫殿里。你们听过这个故事。好吧，所以她得帮她的新母亲和她的新姐妹们打扮好去参加舞会。而她自己不能去。不，不，她不够格去，但她们够格。那她会因此难过吗？不。她是个坚强的小女孩，已经承受了母亲去世的最大悲痛。于是所有人都出发去舞会了。

cues.en: And the fairy godmother shows up and gives her pantyhose, mascara, perfume, everything, means of transportation, carriage with horses and everything. Everything you need to go to a party and have a good time. So, she goes and the prince falls in love with her. Now you must realize, she is so heavily made up that her own relatives don't recognize her.
cues.zh: 仙女教母出现了，给了她连裤袜、睫毛膏、香水，什么都有，还有交通工具、带马的马车等等。去参加舞会、玩得开心所需的一切。于是她去了，王子爱上了她。现在你必须明白，她妆化得太浓，连她自己的亲戚都认不出她。

cues.en: Okay, so the clock strikes 12, as promised, and so she loses all this stuff. It's all taken away, and the fairy godmother said that was gonna happen. There's a very steep drop here. It doesn't take long for a clock to strike 12. Does she drop down to the same level? No, for the rest of her life. She'll remember the time she was the belle of the ball. So she poops along at this considerably improved level.
cues.zh: 好，时钟如约敲响12点，于是她失去了这一切。全都被收走了，仙女教母说过会这样。这里有一个非常陡的下降。钟敲12点用不了多久。她会掉回原来的水平吗？不会，余生都不会。她会记得自己曾是舞会皇后的那段时光。于是她就以这个明显提高的水平继续往前过。

cues.en: until the shoe fits and she becomes off-scale happy. There's a Franz Kafka story. Very pessimistic. Starts down here. There's this rather unattractive, not particularly nice looking, not very personable young man who has a really lousy job and disagreeable relatives. And so...
cues.zh: 直到鞋子合脚，她变得幸福到爆表。有一个 Franz Kafka 的故事。非常悲观。从下面这里开始。有个相当不起眼、长得不怎么好看、也不太讨人喜欢的年轻人，工作很糟糕，亲戚也很难相处。于是……

cues.en: It's time for him to go to work again, and he has turned into a cockroach. All right, now, does this have any use in criticizing literature? Well, I think perhaps it does. I think this rise and fall is in fact artificial. It pretends that we know more about life than we really do.
cues.zh: 又到了他该去上班的时候，他却变成了一只蟑螂。好，那么这在文学批评中有什么用吗？嗯，我觉得也许有。我认为这种起起落落其实是人为的。它假装我们对生活知道得比实际更多。

cues.en: What's perhaps a true masterpiece cannot be crucified on the cross of this design All right Let's try Hamlet. Okay Well, I don't have to draw a new level Sex is a reverse, but he's in the same situation as Cinderella and a little older father has died and His mother is remarried his uncle and so he is depressed as Cinderella so he is
cues.zh: 真正的杰作也许不能被钉死在这种设计的十字架上。好，我们试试《哈姆雷特》。好吧，我不用再画一条新的水平线；情况正好反过来，但他和灰姑娘处境相同，只是年纪大一些——父亲死了，母亲改嫁给了叔叔，所以他像灰姑娘一样抑郁，所以他是……

cues.en: Feeling very unhappy and depressed and everything and his friend Horatio comes in and says hey Hamlet There's this thing up on the parapet. I think you better go talk to it Says it's your father and so Hamlet goes up there and This thing whatever it is now We don't know is any of you who forced around with Ouija boards or with any sort of seances or anything You know there are malicious spirits around
cues.zh: 他感到非常不快乐、抑郁，等等。他的朋友 Horatio 进来说：“嘿，Hamlet，城墙垛口上有东西。我觉得你最好去跟它谈谈。它说是你父亲。”于是 Hamlet 上去了，而那东西——不管它现在是什么——我们不知道。你们有谁玩过通灵板，或者搞过降神会之类的吗？要知道，周围有恶意的鬼魂。

cues.en: who are looking for saps like you, who are going to find ways to hurt you, give you very bad advice. So to this day, we do not know whether that thing up there on the parapet was really the ghost of his father and whether it was telling him the truth. But the thing said, I'm your father. I was murdered by the man who's now the king, and you've got to avenge me. Well, since we don't know what it was, what it is,
cues.zh: 它们在找像你这样的傻瓜，会想办法伤害你，给你非常糟糕的建议。所以直到今天，我们也不知道城墙垛口上那东西到底是不是他父亲的鬼魂，也不知道它有没有对他说实话。但那东西说：“我是你父亲。我被现在当国王的那个人谋杀了，你必须为我报仇。”好吧，既然我们不知道它当时是什么、现在是什么，

cues.en: Neither good news nor bad news because we don't know and so All right Hamlet says I know what I'll do I'll stage a play I'll get higher actors and get them to act out the way The murder was described to me and I'll have the murder suspect suspect watch and watch his reaction Well, okay, so he does that It's a flop none Nothing much happens And so Hamlet is up
cues.zh: 既不是好消息也不是坏消息，因为我们不知道。所以，好，Hamlet 说：“我知道我要做什么了。我要排一出戏。我要雇些演员来，让他们把我听到的谋杀经过演出来，然后让谋杀嫌疑人来看，观察他的反应。”好吧，他就这么做了。结果彻底失败，完全没动静。于是 Hamlet 就上去了，

cues.en: in his mother's chamber, talking right after this flop and talking. And the curtains wave or the aris waves, the drapes wave. And so he figures his uncle is back there, his new father supposedly. And so he's gonna finally be decisive. And he pulls out his sword, sticks it through the drapes. Who falls out? This windbag, Polonius.
cues.zh: 在他母亲的房间里，刚在这出戏失败后说着话。帘子动了，或者说是挂毯动了，帷幕晃了。于是他断定他叔叔——他所谓的新父亲——就在后面。于是他终于要果断一回了。他拔出剑，刺穿帘子。谁掉出来了？这个废话篓子 Polonius。

cues.en: Shakespeare regards him as a total fool and you know giving just the kind of dumb advice parents give their kids when they go away. You know, neither a borrower nor a lender be. Thanks a lot, Dad. What a swell time. Anyway, is this terrible? Is Hamlet gonna get arrested or what? No. It's neither good nor bad news. Just something that happened. All right. So finally,
cues.zh: Shakespeare 觉得他就是个彻头彻尾的蠢蛋，净给些父母在孩子出远门时会给的那种馊主意。比如，“既不要借人钱，也不要向人借钱”。真多谢你了，老爸。多扫兴啊。总之，这很糟糕吗？Hamlet 会被逮捕还是怎样？不会。这既非好消息，也非坏消息。就只是发生了这么一件事。好了。终于，

cues.en: Hamlet gets in the duel and is killed. If he goes to heaven, he's off-scale, happy like Cinderella. If he's going to hell, he's off-scale, unhappy like Kafka's cockroach. But we don't know. I don't think Hamlet believed in heaven and hell anymore than I do. I mean that Shakespeare didn't. So I would just prove to you that...
cues.zh: Hamlet 卷入了决斗并被杀害。要是他去了天堂，他就会开心爆棚，就像 Cinderella 一样。要是他下了地狱，他就会痛苦万分，就像 Kafka 笔下的蟑螂一样。但我们不知道。我觉得 Hamlet 和我一样，压根不信天堂和地狱那一套。我是说 Shakespeare 不信。所以我刚才向大家证明了……

cues.en: Shakespeare was as poor a storyteller as any Arapaho. But I haven't. I have, in fact, told you why this is respected as a masterpiece. We are so seldom told the truth. In Hamlet, Shakespeare tells us we don't know enough about life to know what the good news is and the bad news is, and we respond to that. Thank you, Bill.
cues.zh: Shakespeare 讲故事的能力并不比任何一个 Arapaho 人强。但我并没有这么证明。事实上，我已经告诉了大家为什么这部作品会被奉为杰作。我们太少能听到真相了。在 Hamlet 中，Shakespeare 告诉我们，我们对生活的了解太少，以至于根本分不清什么是好消息，什么是坏消息，而我们对此深有共鸣。谢谢你，Bill。

cues.en: If you think what all we do is we pretend to know what the good news is and what the bad news is, and you think about our training in this matter, all we do is echo the feelings of people around us. Imagine a little kid, three years old, maybe four, and the parents are so excited. They have the most wonderful piece of news for this kid. And there's a little kid, oh boy, what can this be? And it's nice. Here's the terrific news, the bombshell.
cues.zh: 如果你想想看，我们一直在假装知道什么是好消息、什么是坏消息；再想想我们在这方面受到的训练，我们不过是在附和周围人的情绪罢了。想象一个三四岁的小孩，父母兴奋不已。他们要告诉孩子一个天大的好消息。小孩心想，天哪，会是什么呢？太棒了。这个天大的惊喜、重磅炸弹来了——

cues.en: It's your birthday. What could be a more empty piece of information? And so the kid goes, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. And you know, it goes on as our team won. Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. Our candidate won. Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. So although I don't believe in heaven, I would like to go up to such a place once just to ask somebody in charge.
cues.zh: 今天是你的生日！还有比这更空洞的信息吗？于是那孩子就跟着叫，哇，哇，哇！然后接下来一辈子都是这样：我们队赢了！哇，哇，哇！我们支持的候选人赢了！哇，哇，哇！所以，尽管我不信天堂，我倒想去那样的地方走一趟，就为了问问那里的管事人：

cues.en: Hey, what was the good news and what was the bad news? Because we can't be sure. Now, every lecture I've ever given has included my tribute to my Uncle Alex, my brother's kid brother, who was a graduate of Harvard and a wise man with distant insurance salesmen in Indianapolis. He was childish. But what Uncle Alex found objectionable
cues.zh: 嘿，到底什么是好消息，什么是坏消息？因为我们根本说不准。我做过的每一次演讲，都会向我的 Uncle Alex 致敬，他是我父亲的亲弟弟，毕业于 Harvard，在 Indianapolis 当一个心不在焉的保险推销员，是个很有智慧的人。他有点像小孩子。但 Uncle Alex 最看不惯很多人的一点是，

cues.en: about so many human beings is that they seldom noticed it when they were happy. And so we would be sitting under an apple tree, for instance, on a July afternoon drinking lemonade and, you know, talking about this and that, and it's practically buzzy like honey bees. And alcoholics would stop everything and say, wait a minute, stop. If this isn't nice, I don't know what is.
cues.zh: 他们几乎从没意识到自己正身处幸福之中。比如，七月的一个午后，我们会坐在苹果树下喝着柠檬水，东拉西扯地闲聊，耳边伴着蜜蜂的嗡嗡声。Uncle Alex 会突然打断一切，说：“等等，停一下。如果这都不算美好，那什么才算呢？”

cues.en: And so he would do that again and again, and it was very good advice, and I've taken it out. And I hope that you will take up this habit, too, of noticing when things are really awfully nice, and say, if this isn't nice, I don't know who it is. Now then, I don't know how long have I talked? I've lost track, because I'm supposed to speak for 45 minutes. Anybody know how long I've spoken? Huh? About 45?
cues.zh: 于是他一遍又一遍这么做。这是非常好的建议，我也采纳了。希望你也养成这个习惯：留意那些真正美好的事，并且说，如果这都不算好，那我不知道什么才算好。现在，我不知道自己讲了多久？我讲着讲着就忘了，因为我本该讲45分钟。有人知道我讲了多久吗？嗯？差不多45分钟？

cues.en: What? All right, well, I'm going to ask for a show of hands now, so get set for that. And this is for everybody here. Everybody, no matter what age. How many of you have had a teacher at any point in your whole educational career, primary school, high school, college, grad school? How many of you have had a teacher who made you...
cues.zh: 什么？好吧，现在我要请大家举手，所以准备好。这是问在场的每一个人，不管年龄多大。在你们整个受教育经历中，小学、高中、大学、研究生院，有多少人遇到过这样一位老师？有多少人遇到过一位老师，让你……

cues.en: Prouder to be alive, happier to be alive, than you had previously believed possible. Would you show up your hands, please? Those of you who have. All right. Now then, would you please say the name of that teacher to someone sitting next to you? All done? If this isn't nice, I don't know what is. Music, please!
cues.zh: 让你比从前以为可能的更以活着为荣、更因活着而快乐。这样的人请举手，好吗？有过的请举手。好。那么现在，请把那位老师的名字说给坐在你旁边的人听，好吗？都说完了吗？如果这都不算美好，我不知道还有什么算。请放音乐！
